articles.title: Pathfinder Bancorp (PBHC) Stock Price Stalls As Q3 Earnings Face Margin Pressure
articles.summary: Pathfinder Bancorp just posted Q3 2026 results, and the stock barely budged, up only 1.35% to US$17.23. For a bank carrying a trailing P/E of 65.7x and a net profit margin sitting at 4.5%, that muted reaction suggests investors may be cautious rather than celebratory. The central issue appears to be the tension between a relatively rich valuation and an earnings profile that has faced pressure over an extended period.
